---
title: "About"
---

## Background

I grew up in India and spent the last five years working as a data engineer,
most recently building a Microsoft Fabric data platform for an agricultural
insurance provider in Alberta. Before that I worked with the City of Ottawa and
the RCMP, mostly on pipelines, Lakehouses, and the unglamorous plumbing that
makes analytics possible. I moved to Vancouver in August 2026 to start MDS.

## Why data science

After years of moving data from one place to another, I kept running into the
same wall: I could build the pipeline, but I couldn't always say what the
numbers actually meant. MDS is my attempt to close that gap to get properly
fluent in statistics and modelling instead of handing the interesting questions
off to someone else. The R half of the program is new territory for me, which
is part of the appeal.

## Outside of data science

I lift five or six days a week on a push/pull/legs split, and I'm slowly
learning which Vancouver trails are worth the drive. I make my coffee at home
with a Clever Dripper and a hand grinder, which is either a hobby or a mild
compulsion depending on the morning. I also read a fair bit of Indian
philosophy, the Gita and the Ramayana and sit for meditation most days.
